purpose: Teach: 暑かっ/お便り/大通り/用心/台無し/音読/円形/探究

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、昨日のテスト、本気で、暑かった部屋、エアコン、利いてなくて、絶対、つらかったよ、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Riku, yesterday's test — the room was seriously so hot, the AC wasn't even working. It must have been brutal.
lines.style: Quick, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight eye-roll on the complaint, but genuinely concerned underneath. Conversational rhythm, like she's venting to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃんから、お便り、本気で、いっぱい、絶対、もらってるよ、桜、本気で、嬉しい、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. And your grandmother's been sending me letters, Sakura. Seriously so many. I'm… I'm really grateful for that.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. A small pause before admitting the gratitude — like it costs him something to be this sincere. Warm but careful, eyes down slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大通り、本気で、車、結構、走ってるから、リク、絶対、注意して、渡ろうね、本気で、お互いに、約束、絶対。
lines.en: The main road has a lot of traffic, so — let's promise each other we'll be careful crossing, okay? Both of us.
lines.style: Shifts to protective mode. Steady tone, no drama. Direct eye contact. The care is embedded in the practicality, not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夜遅く、本気で、用心しろよ、桜、お父さんも、心配してたぞ、絶対、本気で、家まで、送るからな、絶対、約束。
lines.en: When you're out late — be careful, yeah? Your dad was worried about it. I'll walk you home, I promise.
lines.style: Firm but not stern. A soft undertone of real concern. Takes the promise seriously. Gentle ownership of the responsibility.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当、雨で、本気で、台無しになっちゃったよ、リク、悲しい、絶対、本当に、本気で、明日、また、頼むね。
lines.en: My lunch got completely ruined in the rain today. I was so sad about it, Riku. Can you make me another one tomorrow?
lines.style: Quieter than before. A note of genuine disappointment. Hesitant asking — vulnerable in a way she doesn't usually let show. Small, hopeful at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 国語の授業、本気で、音読、苦手なんだぜ、桜、お前、得意だよな、本気で、絶対、すごい、本気で、感心してる、本当に。
lines.en: I'm terrible at reading aloud in Japanese class, you know? But you're good at it. You're really amazing at it, actually. I'm serious.
lines.style: Self-deprecating opening, then sincere. A slight awkwardness as he pivots to honest praise. Watches her face as he says it. No performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の、本気で、円形の花壇、新しく、絶対、できたよね、リク、お前、見た?きれいだよ、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Did you see the new flower garden they built in the courtyard? The circular one? It's really beautiful, Riku.
lines.style: Brightens noticeably. Eager to share something she noticed. Open, animated. Like she's inviting him into something she found.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、宇宙の探究、興味、絶対、あるよな、桜、本気で、すごい、夢、本当に、絶対、応援してるぜ、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: You're interested in space exploration, aren't you? That's seriously amazing. I really believe in your dream, Sakura.
lines.style: Vulnerable and direct. Leans slightly forward. Says it like he's been wanting to say it. No irony, no self-protection. Warm, steady conviction.
